records.claim: Gabriela Rivadeneira was born on 25 July 1983.
Gabriela Rivadeneira was born in Quito, Ecuador.
Gabriela Rivadeneira's political party is PAIS Alliance.

records.source_span: On 28 July 2011 Rivadeneira took up the function of Governor of Imbabura Province
records.claim: Gabriela Rivadeneira became Governor of Imbabura Province on 28 July 2011.

records.source_span: Rivadeneira was forced to lay down her function of Vice Prefect in the same province
records.claim: Gabriela Rivadeneira was Vice Prefect of Imbabura Province.

records.source_span: On 9 November 2012 Rivadeneira resigned as Governor
records.claim: Gabriela Rivadeneira resigned as Governor of Imbabura Province on 9 November 2012.

records.source_span: On 14 May 2013 Rivadeneira was chosen as President of the National Assembly
records.claim: Gabriela Rivadeneira became President of the National Assembly on 14 May 2013.

records.source_span: She was the Executive Secretary of the PAIS Alliance between 1 May 2017 and 2018
records.value: Executive Secretary of the PAIS Alliance
records.claim: Gabriela Rivadeneira was Executive Secretary of the PAIS Alliance from 1 May 2017 to 2018.

records.source_span: Political party: PAIS Alliance(Before 2018)Citizen Revolution Movement(After 2018)
records.claim: Gabriela Rivadeneira's political party is Citizen Revolution Movement after 2018.

records.source_span: During the Correa-Moreno split within PAIS, she sided with the former, leaving the party and becoming one of the leaders of the Citizen Revolution Movement
records.claim: Gabriela Rivadeneira became one of the leaders of the Citizen Revolution Movement after leaving PAIS Alliance.
